F7_THE_CANONICAL_BOARD_BUILD_DOES_NOT_RU.severity: the most serious finding in this arm, and it was found only because two seats compared two boards
F7_THE_CANONICAL_BOARD_BUILD_DOES_NOT_RU.what: rl_export.py — the canonical board build — calls, in bake/gate/canonical mode, ONLY _FVP.verify_config_manifest() and _BG.assert_fv_provenance(_TROOT) (rl_export.py:37-44). It NEVER calls _BG.assert_boot(). So blocks (0) store, (0c) board, (0d) fitted-artifact CHECKOUT integrity and (0e) fitted-artifact LOAD-PATH integrity are not invoked by the board build at all.
F7_THE_CANONICAL_BOARD_BUILD_DOES_NOT_RU.consequence_measured_not_argued: with RL_Q97M_PKL unset, the export loaded /home/claude/q97m.pkl (cfdc7321) against a root pinning fd794c0b, and EXITED 0. A board was written, stamped and reported on a ceiling that does not match its own boot pin, with no verdict anywhere.
F7_THE_CANONICAL_BOARD_BUILD_DOES_NOT_RU.the_guard_itself_is_fine: boot_guard, when actually asked, HALTS correctly on exactly this input — proven by direct invocation, exit 1, naming the resolved path and the expected pin (transcripts/RECONCILE_guard5_halts_when_asked.txt). The defect is that the exporter does not ask.
F7_THE_CANONICAL_BOARD_BUILD_DOES_NOT_RU.who_does_call_it: bootstrap.sh, run_panel.sh, ship_gates_check.py and one_source_selftest.py all call assert_boot. rl_export.py does not — so a board can be BUILT unguarded and only later be judged by a downstream instrument, if one is run at all.
F7_THE_CANONICAL_BOARD_BUILD_DOES_NOT_RU.why_it_matters_beyond_this_arm: the (0e) load-path block exists BECAUSE of register item 91 — the owner-caught q97m/cm load-path hole of 2026-07-14, where an env var could point the engine at any pickle and the guard still passed. The block was written and mirrored correctly. The board exporter was never wired to it, so the hole stayed open at the one site that writes the board. This is also law 2 (SILENCE IS A RED) and process law P2 (NEVER BOOT ON AN UNVERIFIED STORE) at the canonical build site.
F7_THE_CANONICAL_BOARD_BUILD_DOES_NOT_RU.not_fixed_here: wiring assert_boot into rl_export.py would change what the canonical build does and is outside an arm with no design content. Reported for a ruling. NOTE for whoever takes it: the fix must be measured against a live rebuild, because assert_boot's (0c) block asserts data/rl_build/rl_app_data.json against the 'board' pin — at a bake the board being generated is BY DESIGN not yet equal to it.

findings_not_on_the_list.F6_shared_scratchpad_carries_a_stale_rl_: the session scratchpad is persistent and holds an rl_model.py from an earlier seat. Any diagnostic script RUN FROM that directory silently imports it instead of the engine's (it crashed one probe here with KeyError: 'cap_against_curve_pick', which is how it was found). Every measurement in this arm was run from a clean directory and is unaffected — but a future seat that drops a probe there will get a wrong answer that looks right.
